The '''NA LCS 2018 Summer Split''' was the second split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS) under the franchising system, organized by Riot Games. It ran from June 16 to September 9, 2018, with the Regular Season held in Los Angeles, United States, and the Playoffs in Oakland, United States. Ten permanent partner teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD. The Summer champion qualified for the [[World Championship/2018|2018 World Championship]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of Playoffs.
**** 1st place team from Group Stage will select their opponent from Quarterfinals
**** 2nd place team from Group Stage will face the remaining team from Quarterfinals
* '''Playoffs'''
** Quarterfinals played on August 25-26, 2018 in NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles, California.
** Semifinals played on September 01-02, 2018 in NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles, California.
** Finals and 3rd place match played on September 08-09, 2018 in Oracle Arena in Oakland, California.
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
* Winner Qualifies for [[World Championship/2018|Worlds 2018]]
